BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the veterans innovations program; amending RCW43.60A.185; repealing RCW 43.131.405 and 43.131.406; and makingappropriations.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 43.60A.185 and 2010 1st sp.s. c 37 s 924 are eachamended to read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The veterans innovations program account is created in thestate treasury. Moneys in the account may be spent only afterappropriation. Expenditures from the account may be used only forpurposes of the veterans innovations program. ((During the 20092011fiscal biennium, the funds may be used for contracting for veterans'claims assistance services.)) (2)(a) If the legislature increases future appropriations for theveterans innovations program above the amounts provided in the 20112013 omnibus appropriations act, the additional amounts may be used toprovide program grants to any veteran, as defined in RCW 73.08.005.Applicants for such grants, other than members of the Washingtonnational guard and reservists eligible under RCW 43.60A.165, must showevidence of local matching resources before the grant may be awarded. p. 1 HB 1280 (b) If the legislature does not increase future appropriations forthe veterans innovations program above the amounts provided in the20112013 omnibus appropriations act, the department shall continue toprovide program grants exclusively to members of the Washingtonnational guard and reservists eligible under RCW 43.60A.165.

The following acts or parts of acts are eachrepealed: RCW 43.131.405 (Veterans innovations programTermination) and2006 c 343 s 10; and RCW 43.131.406 (Veterans innovations programRepeal) and 20101st sp.s. c 37 s 925, 2010 1st sp.s. c 7 s 116, & 2006 c 343 s 11.

(1) The sum of eight hundred sixty thousanddollars, or as much thereof as may be necessary, is appropriated forthe biennium ending June 30, 2015, from the veterans innovationsprogram accountstate to the department of veterans affairs for thepurposes of the veterans innovations program. (2) Fifty thousand dollars of the veterans innovations programappropriation in this section is for the purposes of section 1(2)(a) ofthis act.
